mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY growth exceeds 2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth is above 2%, the combination signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a 0.25% increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a shift towards tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
